p_isola: The Municipality of Serracapriola provides residents with a recycling centre for the separate disposal of special waste, bulky items and materials not collectable through normal kerbside collection.
mat_1_desc: Furniture, mattresses, sofas, large household appliances.
mat_2_desc: Computers, televisions, phones, fridges, washing machines.
mat_3_desc: Spent batteries of any type, car and motorbike batteries.
mat_5_desc: Prunings, grass, leaves, branches and plant waste.
mat_6_desc: Concrete fragments, tiles, small building materials.
mat_7_desc: Motor oil, used cooking oil in appropriate containers.
mat_8_desc: Expired or unused medicines, even without packaging.
mat_9_desc: Paint tins, solvents, household chemical products.
warn_nota: ⚠️ Note: Opening hours and accepted materials may vary. Contact the Municipality or the service provider for up-to-date information.
